summary.business_type: Travel Guide / Historical Content (Information site targeting US English audience)
top_findings: Schema JSON-LD broken on all 18 detail pages due to {{}} escaping bug
Tailwind CDN script in <head> blocks first paint and adds 1-3s to LCP
No og:image or twitter:image on any page -- social previews invisible
18 images total 3.8 MB with no responsive srcset
No llms.txt for AI crawler discoverability
quick_wins: Fix schema JSON-LD escape bug across all detail pages (1-2 hours, one build pipeline fix)
Add og:image / twitter:image to every page (1 hour, one tag per page)
Add responsive srcset and width/height to all images (3-4 hours)
Recompress images with cwebp -q 75 to reduce payload ~50% (1 hour)
Create llms.txt at site root (30 minutes)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Clean robots.txt with sitemap reference
Sitemap.xml covers all 19 pages with proper lastmod
Canonical URLs correct on all pages
Meta robots index,follow on every page
No broken internal links detected

findings.title: Schema JSON-LD broken on all 18 detail pages
findings.description: Every detail page uses {{ and }} as JSON delimiters in schema LD+JSON blocks. This renders structured data unparseable by Google. Only the homepage schema is correct. File: sites/foguang/index.html line ~21 and all siblings.
findings.recommendation: Fix build pipeline so { and } are not escaped. Rebuild all 18 detail pages. Validate with Google Rich Results Test.

findings.title: No security headers configured
findings.description: No CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, or X-Frame-Options headers visible in source. Server config not present in repo.
findings.recommendation: Add HSTS max-age=31536000, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN via server config.

findings.title: Sitemap changefreq and priority provide no value
findings.description: All entries use changefreq=monthly and identical priority 0.8. Google primarily uses lastmod.
findings.recommendation: Keep lastmod, drop changefreq and priority from all entries except homepage.

findings.title: Trailing slash inconsistency risk
findings.description: Sitemap uses trailing slashes. If server serves both with and without, duplicate content may emerge.
findings.recommendation: Verify server redirects non-trailing-slash URLs to trailing-slash versions.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique, keyword-rich title tags on all 19 pages
Unique meta descriptions on all pages
H1 on every page with clean heading hierarchy
OG and Twitter Card tags present on all pages
Strong internal linking with breadcrumbs and cross-references
Mobile-responsive navigation

findings.title: Missing og:image on all pages
findings.description: No og:image or twitter:image meta tags on any of the 19 pages. Social shares (Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, Discord) show no preview image.
findings.recommendation: Add og:image pointing to each site hero image. Add og:image:width and og:image:height for faster social rendering.

findings.title: Homepage title could be shorter
findings.description: Current title is 82 chars. Google may truncate after 60-70 chars.
findings.recommendation: Consider shortening to Tang vs Song Dynasty: What Survives Today | Relics Guide (61 chars).

findings.title: Detail page meta descriptions are formulaic
findings.description: All detail pages follow the same template: Complete travel guide to [Site] in [City], [Province]. Functional but does not entice clicks.
findings.recommendation: Lead each meta description with the most compelling fact about that specific site.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Authenticity label system (4-tier) is genuinely differentiating
Every site has Basis citation (NPU, UNESCO, State Council)
Honest note system builds E-E-A-T trust
Detail pages comprehensive: 6 travel sections each
FAQ section targets real search queries with substantive answers
No thin or duplicate pages
Chinese dynasty timeline with distinguishing facts

findings.title: No author attribution or About page
findings.description: Organization schema used for authorship but no About page, author bio, or contact info. E-E-A-T signals benefit from transparent authorship.
findings.recommendation: Add /about/ page with organization details, editorial standards, and contact method.

findings.title: Some Why Visit sections reuse homepage text
findings.description: For Toshodai-ji and Horyu-ji, the Why Visit text is identical to the homepage card description.
findings.recommendation: Expand each Why Visit to 3-4 unique sentences.

findings.title: No per-page content freshness signals
findings.description: Footer says Facts verified: 2026-08 on all pages uniformly.
findings.recommendation: Add per-page dateModified in schema and a Last updated line in page footers.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Homepage: Article, FAQPage, Table, ItemList (TouristAttraction x18), BreadcrumbList
FAQPage with 13 Q&A pairs is excellent for AI Overviews
BreadcrumbList on all detail pages
TouristAttraction on all detail pages

findings.title: All detail page schemas unparseable due to {{}} bug
findings.description: Double-brace escaping makes every schema block on 18 detail pages invalid JSON-LD. Google Rich Results Test fails.
findings.recommendation: Fix build pipeline. Same issue as Technical SEO finding #1.

findings.title: Missing Organization schema
findings.description: No Organization or WebSite schema on homepage. Foundational schema type missing.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization schema with name Relics Guide and URL.

findings.title: Missing ImageObject in TouristAttraction
findings.description: Each TouristAttraction should have an image property pointing to ImageObject with caption and dimensions.
findings.recommendation: Extend TouristAttraction schema to include image URLs with dimensions.

findings.title: Table schema is minimal
findings.description: Table schema on homepage has only an about field with no actual table data.
findings.recommendation: Populate with Tang vs Song comparison table data or remove.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Inline critical CSS avoids external stylesheet blocking
No analytics or tracking scripts
No advertising scripts
WebP format for all images
No heavy frameworks (React, Vue)
Static HTML -- fast server-side

findings.title: Tailwind CDN script blocks first paint
findings.description: script src=https://cdn.tailwindcss.com loaded synchronously in head. Blocks HTML parsing until CDN script downloads, parses, and scans DOM. Adds 1-3s to FCP/LCP on slow connections.
findings.recommendation: Build Tailwind locally: npx tailwindcss -i input.css -o output.css --minify. Serve as static file.

findings.title: Images oversized and not responsive (3.8 MB total)
findings.description: 18 WebP images total 3.8 MB with no srcset. Largest: baoguo.webp (286 KB), famen.webp (272 KB).
findings.recommendation: Generate 400w/800w/1200w variants. Recompress with cwebp -q 75. Add srcset and sizes attributes.

findings.title: Google Fonts add network dependency
findings.description: Three font families loaded from Google CDN. Even with preconnect, adds latency and blocks rendering.
findings.recommendation: Self-host font files with font-display: swap.

findings.title: Inline CSS duplicated across 18 detail pages
findings.description: Each detail page has identical style block (~500 bytes). Not a major perf hit but is code duplication.
findings.recommendation: Extract into shared external stylesheet with cache-friendly headers.

categories.name: Images
what_works: All images in WebP format
All images have alt text
Proper aspect ratios via CSS classes
Consistent naming convention
No broken image references

findings.title: No responsive image variants (srcset)
findings.description: Every img tag serves a single file. Mobile users on 3G download same 286 KB as desktop on fiber.
findings.recommendation: Generate 400w, 800w, 1200w variants and use srcset + sizes.

findings.title: 7 images over 250 KB
findings.description: baoguo.webp: 286 KB, famen.webp: 272 KB, mogao.webp: 269 KB, shosoin.webp: 266 KB, jinci.webp: 258 KB, huqiu.webp: 254 KB, daming.webp: 251 KB.
findings.recommendation: Recompress with cwebp -q 75. Target: all images under 150 KB.

findings.title: Missing width and height attributes
findings.description: No img tags include width/height attributes. Causes Cumulative Layout Shift.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit dimensions matching natural aspect ratio.

findings.title: Detail pages have no hero image
findings.description: Detail pages are text-only above the fold. Image exists in images/ but not used.
findings.recommendation: Add hero img to each detail page header section above H1.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: FAQPage schema well-structured for AI Overview extraction
BreadcrumbList helps AI crawlers understand hierarchy
Clear, definitional prose easy for AI models to cite
Substantive factual claims with specific data points
No paywalls or login gates

findings.title: No llms.txt file
findings.description: llms.txt not present at site root. Primary discovery mechanism for LLM crawlers missing.
findings.recommendation: Create llms.txt listing key pages with brief descriptions.

findings.title: No About page for brand authority signals
findings.description: AI models evaluate site authority partially based on About/Contact signals. Currently absent.
findings.recommendation: Add /about/ page with organization info and editorial policy.

findings.title: No citation-friendly paragraph anchors
findings.description: Travel sections cannot be deep-linked at paragraph level.
findings.recommendation: Add id attributes to section headings for external deep-linking.

findings.title: No analytics to measure AI traffic
findings.description: No visibility into AI crawler referral patterns or traffic sources.
findings.recommendation: Add Plausible or Cloudflare Web Analytics (privacy-respecting, no cookies).

Add og:image and twitter:image to all 19 pages
Remove Tailwind CDN, build CSS locally and serve as static file

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Recompress images and add responsive srcset (3.8 MB -> ~2.0 MB target)
Create llms.txt for AI crawler discoverability
Extract shared inline CSS to external stylesheet

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Add Organization + WebSite schema to homepage
Expand thin Why Visit sections for Japan/theme park sites
Add hero images to detail pages above H1

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Set up Google Search Console for indexation and performance monitoring
Sitemap cleanup: remove changefreq/priority, verify redirect consistency
Run Lighthouse audits post-optimization: target LCP < 2.5s, CLS < 0.1
